name: winona
profile:
**Winona** is Applejack's female brown-and-white, Border-Collie-like farm dog in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)—not a pony. Spot her by her red collar, gold tag, white muzzle/chest/paws, white-tipped tail, and energetic herding. She helps round up cows and rabbits in **“Applebuck Season” (S1E4)**, her debut. [Character and episode record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Winona).

**Name/history:** **Winona** is her established show/guidebook name, not a fan invention. A licensed UK magazine and US *Applebuck Season* storybook called her **Jackaroo**—a publication variant, not a separate character. Lauren Faust reportedly used **Brandy**, then **Buckaroo** during development, and modeled Winona after her own Australian shepherd, Lucy. [Behind-the-scenes report](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2013/03/random-mlp-facts-from-lauren-faust.html).

**Appearances:** Look for her chasing multiple Pinkie Pies in **“Too Many Pinkie Pies,”** enjoying belly rubs during **“Just for Sidekicks,”** delivering a note in **“P.P.O.V. (Pony Point of View),”** and in **“Going to Seed”** and **“The Last Problem.”** She joins the other pets in IDW's *Friendship Is Magic* **#23**.

**Voice/continuity:** Winona **barks and growls but does not speak**; no separate spoken-role voice actor is verified. **Equestria Girls** has an analogous human-world dog Winona, appearing in **“Pet Project”** and at the pet show in **“Best in Show: The Pre-Show”**—a counterpart, not a pony's secret identity. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y6DGtiNbMs8). A stylized Winona also appears in the separate *Pony Life* adaptation's **“Terrorarium.”** [Episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/terrorarium-bubble-trouble/umc.cmc.2f92arugc284gm6n857xk2ypt?showId=umc.cmc.36xeo4umqn64lubfylwvoizq0).
